chapter: Probation, Las Vegas and Los Angeles in the 1950s
title: Jazz City with Sweets and a girl drummer
summary: He played Maynard's Jazz City and a forum led by Sam Most.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: That's Maynard's place on Hollywood Boulevard? Near Western.

Yeah. Yeah. And worked there for awhile with Sweets. Buddy Rich wasn't in the band. And Sonny Criss Christ. And they had this girl drummer. I can't remember her name. She didn't work steady, but she worked maybe two or three nights out of the week. And the piano player, I can't recall who was playing piano. But my last gig there, like they were holding something like a forum of music. It wasn't jam sessions or anything like that. They would get up a hand-picked group, you know, and one person would be presenting it, you know. And this one person happened to be Sam Most, and he had this girl drummer with him, too.
Yes. And I spoke to her out here on the telephone somewhere and -- did I speak to her on the telephone, or met her? I talked to her in person out at the Times. That's what it was.
